verdict.rationale: MoonPay is a crypto on/off-ramp and payments provider, so agent-initiated stablecoin payments under human-set spend controls is a fair question for it. The evidence covers human-driven buy/sell flows that use MFA, OTP auth and quote signatures. The only agent-related item is an MCP server for searching and retrieving documentation, not for executing payments. Nothing in the pack documents agent payment flows, scoped authority or human-configured spend limits.
